message.content: In Christian theology, **Jesus Christ** is regarded as the most central and pivotal figure. While other prophets—such as Moses, Isaiah, and John the Baptist—are highly respected and play crucial roles in the biblical narrative, Jesus is seen as the fulfillment of the prophetic tradition. He is believed to be the incarnate Son of God, the Messiah, and the ultimate revelation of divine truth, making him the focal point of Christian faith and worship.
